selector.why: the microscopic description of sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios and pseudo-rosette formation, along with immunohistochemical stains showing diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1, specifically supports Desmoplastic Small Round Cell Tumor.

support_spans: microscopically, the tumor invaded from the serosal surface into the myometrium and comprised sheets of small, round hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, frequent mitoses (32 per 10 high-power fields), pseudo-rosette formation, foci of cytoplasmic clearing, and necrosis
immunohistochemical stains showed diffuse positivity for CD99, KIT, and cyclin D1
contradict_spans: history of stage III invasive ductal breast carcinoma
